dependency_edges.handoff: The phase-aware thermodynamic balance supplies the field PDE's source, boundary, and initial conditions.
The fitted temperature field and gradient become the reduced interface in the universal thermodynamic model.

Motion-adjusted temperature fields are evaluated against the human comfort distribution.
Comfort probability, temperature deviation, and water use become the Strategy I objective and constraints.
The same comfort and energy criteria are recast for piecewise tap switching.
The selected continuous strategy is reused after bubble-interface losses are modified.
